documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: We are an existing customer in partner support. Our workflow stopped after a configuration change. Please get support involved before discussing expansion. This is a support incident.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer is an existing Cedar Systems client currently in partner support, reporting that their workflow stopped after a configuration change. They explicitly state that this is a support incident and request that support be involved before any discussion of expansion. The account is in the 'customer' stage with verified consent and ownership by 'cedar-east'.
raw_proposal.draft: We understand that your workflow has stopped following a configuration change, and we appreciate your clarification that this is a support incident. Our support team is available to assist with resolving this issue. Please provide any additional details you feel would be helpful for them to address the problem efficiently.
questions: Can you provide any error messages or logs related to the configuration change?
Have you already contacted Cedar Systems support for this issue?
uncertainties: The exact nature of the configuration change and its impact on the workflow.
